law: Use the Analytics Report API to analyze data about your apps on Apple platforms.
To start receiving reports, use the endpoint in the App Store Connect API.
After you create your request, use to poll the list of report instances to check whether new instances are downloadable.
Rely on column names instead of column positions in the report files to ensure smoother schema upgrades.

This approach reflects how different users use your app: For each detailed report row, the total session duration is noised so that, approximately: 68.2% of the time the reported value is expected to be within +/- the corresponding deviation of the true value.
Here’s an example noise deviation calculation: If a specific report row has 100,000 true total duration seconds and 5,000 sessions, then the average session duration is 20 seconds.

Sessions is separately noised with 1: For the report row with 100,000 true total duration seconds, approximately: 68.2% of the time the reported value appears within +/- 5 seconds (between 99,995 and 100,005).
Use these reports to estimate the number of App Clip card views, App Clip installations, App Clip Sessions, and session duration.
